messages:
alex: Kicking off canary for release v1.12.4 in the late window. Flag=llm-new-routing-experiment. Window 23:30-01:00 UTC. Plan: 1% sticky -> 5% -> 15% (verify at each step). Pin model to redwood-v2-2026-03 for the experiment.
jun: I'll validate logs and trace samples. Watching tail-error-rate, 99p latency, model mem OOMs.
deploy-bot: deploy requested by alex: route-api@sha256:def456, model=redwood-v2-2026-03, feature=llm-new-routing-experiment OFF.
oncall: Oncall here. Baseline thresholds: user-error > 0.9% for 3m OR 99p latency > 900ms = critical. Escalate to @infra + page.
pm-olivia: Need a short customer note: "Experiment: progressive rollout of improved routing for heavy LLM workloads." Keep it non-committal.
jun: Suggest sticky sampling (session-affinity) for 30m for the 1% cohort to reduce churn noise. Also enabling request-id tagging: header X-Exp-Cohort.
alex: Agree. Enabling session-affinity TTL=30m. Adding header tag.
deploy-bot: feature toggle llm-new-routing-experiment -> ENABLED cohort=canary-1pct (sticky=true) at 7050000020
jun: Canary live. Quick check: 5m metrics: errors 0.05%, 99p latency +20ms, mem stable.
oncall: :thumbsup: I'll watch next 10m. If anything spikes, run rollback.
infra: Reminder: keep model-pin in deployment config until we validate logs for 12h. If we see model-regression, pin back to redwood-v1.
alex: Next step scheduled: expand to 5% at +12m if green. deploy-bot schedule: cohort expand to canary-5pct at 7050000140
deploy-bot: scheduled cohort expansion recorded.
jun: 5% expansion live. Initial 10m: errors 0.3% (warning), 99p latency +90ms (warning), token cost +8%. No criticals.
pm-olivia: From product POV: if warnings persist >15m, we should halt and run a manual analysis.
oncall: Agreed. Rolling thresholds: warning window = 15m sustained warnings triggers manual pause.
ajun: small fix: correlate by user-agent; traffic shape different on mobile vs web. I'll send filter.
alex: Good catch. Please attach filter to dashboard.
jun: Added filter. Mobile cohort shows slightly higher latency; web looks rock-solid. Suggest holding 15% step for morning push for mobile-heavy periods.
infra: If we decide to proceed later, we'll remove the model-pin after 24h stable and promote to default routing. Otherwise rollback plan: disable flag, redeploy prior route routing config, and revert model pin. Runbook: /runbook/llm-routing-rollback.
oncall: If criticals hit, immediate action: disable flag (deploy-bot), ping infra, and open incident channel.
alex: Locking decision: hold at 5% for tonight (mobile concerns). We'll revisit tomorrow UTC morning for 15%. Updating release ticket.
pm-olivia: I'll mark release note as "experiment - paused for mobile analysis" and +1 to informing a small set of customers in the beta list.
jun: I'll collect trace samples for mobile and put in ticket.
deploy-bot: cohort llm-new-routing-experiment set to 5% (held) at 7050000075
oncall: Acknowledged. Closing the thread unless we need to act.
alex: Thanks everyone. Postmortem: only if we take corrective action; otherwise short rollout note in ticket. :white_check_mark:
